engineeringSkip.reason: A topical spray cannot repair telomeres in real time — telomerase acts inside the cell nucleus and topical peptides do not penetrate to that level, so the claimed mechanism has no basis in known biology.

factCheck.reason: Telomeres sit inside cell nuclei and cannot be 'repaired in real time' by a topical mist, and the claim mixes unrelated biology (telomerase, hair follicles) into a cosmetic spray with no basis in known science.
